investigation_notes.Playbook Used: Azure Network Security Group Modification Triage
investigation_notes.Description: An Azure virtual network delete operation was initiated from Lagos, Nigeria (IP 102.89.1.20) by Olumide Adeyemi, owner-level access, targeting a test environment VNet in resource group rg-baltic-test-connectivity. A prior similar alert indicated a location anomaly for this user in Nigeria, which was closed as a false positive, suggesting travel-related or legitimate administrative activity. Given the non-production target and the user's role, this activity is assessed as Low Priority, though continued monitoring is recommended to confirm ongoing authorized behavior.
